query: I have to give my first presentation at work next week. To speak calmly and clearly. I dread how it will land.
how: Same logic as home_dashboard() in server.py: Retriever.search(query, k=len(chunks), balance=False); keep chunks whose kind is allowed ('voice' first; 'voice'+'life' only if no voice chunk qualifies); passage = _trim_passage(chunk text); the app stops collecting after 3. 'considered_by_app' marks those 3; the remaining clean candidates are listed for completeness. Pick = sha256(day + mentor_key) % number_considered. No model call; passages are exactly what _trim_passage returns, unedited.
